verdict.rationale: Jira's first-party docs state that users can choose from over 3,000 integrations in the Atlassian Marketplace to extend Jira, which covers the marketplace and 'thousands of tools' parts of the story. Named examples (Tempo Timesheets, Zephyr) and native integrations (Bitbucket, Slack, Figma, Trello, Confluence) reinforce this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace experience; the community evidence never discusses marketplace apps.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Choose from the over 3000+ integrations available in the Atlassian Marketplace.
Tempo Timesheets, Zephyr, and over 3,000 other apps ensure Jira Software can be custom tailored to fit any and every use case.
